verdict.comment: Abingworth bids to complete a hat-trick, but GOD'S OWN GETAWAY may be able to reverse recent Warwick placings with him.

comments.abingworth: Back in prime form at end of last season, winning twice over 2m4f on good ground
comments.byzantineempire: Won over hurdles here last summer but absent since pulled up over fences in November
comments.fullmonty: Safely held in both handicap hurdles; makes chasing debut after 205-day layoff
comments.godsowngetaway: Very respectable third to Abingworth at Warwick last month and remains on workable mark
comments.marysfortune: Back under rules with two low-key runs this year; cheekpieces refitted today
comments.midnightjewel: May have needed last month's low-key reappearance run but others appeal more all the same
comments.okavangodelta: Not at best on latest outing but was a dual chase winner for his new stable last season
comments.sceneone: On a good mark but does not always look enthusiastic; headgear switched again
comments.unclearthur: Struggled last season and is 10lb wrong for first run since October
comments.wingedisle: Very tricky to weigh up on stable debut but is well handicapped and has conditions to suit

verdict.comment: This is trappy and several can have their case argued. DARKENED EDGE has an absence to defy but appeals as the type to progress again.

comments.cocohill: Two fair runs for new yard in March (6f, AW); down in trip but others appeal more
comments.darkenededge: Bath win (5f, firm) last summer and also ran well over C&D; absence to defy; may do better
comments.fishermanscottage: Made a winning reappearance over 6f nine days ago; not well in under a penalty
comments.glamorousjoy: Salisbury win last summer (5f) off 3lb lower; makes stable debut after seven-month absence
comments.professortickle: Two runs for current stable need bettering; change of headgear not enough to tempt
comments.savannahsmiles: Not at best when last seen and 5f a query; good mark though and Rossa Ryan booked
comments.streetlife: Solid placed efforts on AW the last twice; ran well over C&D last summer; contender
comments.wedgewood: Better on AW but handicapped accordingly (6lb lower than for recent win); one to consider

races.raceComment: wedgewood is marginally preferred with a score of 52.5%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form over streetlife. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 15 attempts. Key attributes include excellent form and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Johnjay will be dangerous if the rain arrives but DAPPLED LIGHT is selected to build on his reappearance under suitable conditions.

comments.dappledlight: Last month's return was encouraging enough and he has finished 2nd in both C&D runs; solid
comments.dogged: On a handy mark but 1m on fast ground perhaps an insufficient test nowadays; stable debut
comments.glenesk: Dropped to a basement mark but as a result of offering little for his current stable
comments.glencalvie: Down in weights and there was more promise tried in cheekpieces last time; not ruled out
comments.happychandler: 0-7 and not progressing in handicaps; cheekpieces now tried
comments.johnjay: Infrequent winner but capable at this level; could probably do with some rain though
comments.letterofthelaw: No show on AW this spring but should prove a different proposition back over 1m & on turf
comments.nexttrick: Not built on a promising stable debut in January (1m, AW); enough to prove for now
comments.outrace: Back in form when 3rd at Bath last week; dangerous mark if building on it; can front run
comments.portnoir: Below par last time but she had been running well prior to that; two course wins; chance
comments.royaljustice: Yet to build on her fair stable debut; best turf form has come on slower than good

races.raceComment: dappledlight is confidently preferred with a score of 61.6%, holding clear edges in superior course form over letterofthelaw. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Devasboy and ROMANOVICH are both handily treated and the latter can record a third C&D success.

comments.ajrad: First and third in two course runs; in form on AW this year; shouldn't be too far away
comments.devasboy: On a long losing run but his Wolverhampton 3rd eight weeks ago was promising; contender
comments.diamondcottage: Just touched off at Salisbury nine days ago (6f); C&D winner; each-way claims again
comments.dynamitekatie: Twice second over C&D last season but opposable after a low-key return two weeks ago
comments.embarked: Infrequent winner but he's coming here in good form and should make another bold bid
comments.expecto: Well beaten in two runs for her new stable this spring; lots to prove for now
comments.factorfable: Conditions to suit, on a good mark and interesting with D Probert replacing apprentices
comments.marisitta: Exposed 13-race maiden; the return of cheekpieces isn't enough to tempt this time
comments.myclementine: C&D winner last summer; dangerous mark if ready to go after absence; check the betting
comments.olympicquest: Not at best on AW this year and her turf form leaves her with plenty to find
comments.peacheycarnehan: Veteran who wasn't in much form on AW early in the year
comments.ravenglass: Not at best the last twice but in good form prior to that; one of two runners for the yard
comments.romanovich: C&D win last year; finished fast for 2nd at Wolverhampton when last seen; big player
comments.toomuchtrevor: Exposed maiden who is yet to fire for new connections; enough to prove for now

races.raceComment: romanovich is marginally preferred with a score of 55.2%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over diamondcottage. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 2 wins from 6 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.
